items.title: No results reported separately for patients over 75
items.whyItMatters: A third of the centre's patients are 75 or over and none of the pooled trials reported them separately (claim c2), so the committee cannot tell whether the lease would help them.
items.opportunity: Extract age-specific results where trials report them, list trials that excluded older patients, and state the gap plainly.

items.title: Function, not steps, is the decision-critical outcome
items.whyItMatters: Step count gains are consistent (claim c1) but function is uncertain, and walking volume may follow recovery rather than cause it.
items.opportunity: Make patient-reported function at about three months the review's primary outcome and report steps as secondary.

items.title: Device use falls after six weeks
items.whyItMatters: Falling wear (claim c3) limits benefit and raises the cost per patient who actually uses the device.
items.opportunity: Report adherence at 6 and 12 weeks as a separate review outcome.

items.title: Digital exclusion among older and rural patients
items.whyItMatters: People without smartphones, living alone or with poor coverage stop early (claim c4) and could be left with worse follow-up than now.
items.opportunity: Extract data on offline devices, loaned phones or clinic synchronisation, and flag trials that required a smartphone.

items.title: The pooled evidence is four years old
items.whyItMatters: The meta-analysis searched to March 2022, and a small or changing evidence base is where rapid and full reviews disagree most.
items.opportunity: Run a dated update search from January 2022 and state every shortcut.

errorsFound: The supplier's brochure presents step count gains as recovery gains; the retrieved evidence separates the two.
reevaluation: The rapid review should update the 2022 search, make function at about three months its primary outcome, and report adherence, physiotherapist time and results for older and digitally excluded patients as separate questions.
summary: Five gaps; missing results for older patients and the uncertain function outcome are high severity.
